brief.text: Medical and healthcare companies feature heavily across the filings, with ENOV, ATEC, ETRA, and STLN all attracting insider commitments. Upbound Group (UPBD) stood out for its breadth of participation, drawing eight distinct insider buyers totaling $1,840,818—far exceeding the two-to-three buyers seen at every other listed company. Six Flags Entertainment (FUN) led all tickers in overall volume at $15,066,320, overwhelmingly driven by a single $14,929,000 purchase from director Rehan Jaffer, alongside GLXY which logged $10,192,678 across two insiders.
